messages:
eva: FYI — after the RBAC refactor deployed at 02:10UTC, I can't toggle the canary on staging. API returns 403. Anyone else seeing this?

sam: I'm seeing it too. CLI toggles fail with 'permission denied: ops.canary_toggle' even though I had access yesterday.

jordan: That smells like role name changes. We renamed some permissions to rollout.* yesterday. Did the mapping get updated for the ops group?

leah: Paging @deploy-bot for recent deploy metadata. Was there a migration step that updated role bindings?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: release/infra/rbac-refactor applied by leah at 02:08UTC. Migration script: `rbac_migrate_v2->v3` ran on staging nodes.

audit-bot: audit-bot: 1965432001: rolebinding-update for group:eng-ops changed: ops.canary_toggle -> rollout.operator, removed legacy ops.* rules.

sam: OK so binding exists but name changed. Our canary toggle checks for ops.canary_toggle literal string. The API gate is still using the old permission string.

eva: Great catch. Is there a quick workaround? Can someone add a compatibility binding or update the gate? We need to unstick canaries for a customer test at 03:00UTC.

jordan: Short term: add a rolebinding that maps rollout.operator -> ops.canary_toggle (legacy alias) or patch the gate to check both. I can open a patch but will take ~15m.

leah: I'll apply a temporary rolebinding in staging. Also double-check KMS access — last time a refactor broke service-account scopes and then deploys failed to read encrypted rollout flags.

sam: Confirmed: KMS logs show a few Decrypt failures around 02:09UTC from svc-deploy-staging@redwood-inference. Error: `permissionDenied: caller does not have permission to decrypt`. Not sure if related but could affect cached rollout state.

eva: If KMS fails, canary toggle could succeed in auth but fail when reading encrypted flag; but here the error is 403 at the gate. Sounds strictly RBAC string mismatch.

jordan: I'll push a one-line guard to the rollout gate: `if has_any_perm(user, ['ops.canary_toggle','rollout.operator']) allow` and deploy to staging canary. If that works, we'll schedule a proper refactor of permission checks.

leah: temp rolebinding applied: `kubectl create rolebinding ops-compat --clusterrole=rollout.operator --group=eng-ops --namespace=staging` (applied at 02:18UTC). Can someone retest?

sam: Retest ok from my shell: `curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.internal/canary/toggle -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -d '{"enabled":true}'` now returns 200. :thumbsup:

eva: Thanks. Next steps: (1) jordan to land gate patch with dual-permission check and tests; (2) leah to run RBAC migration audit across org to find other gate literals; (3) sam to validate KMS decrypt perms for svc-deploy. Assigning followups.

jordan: Will open PR with tests and a migration note. Will also add a lint that flags literal permission strings in codebase.

leah: I'll run `rbac-audit --teams eng-ops,eng-platform` and post results. If we see more mismatches, we'll roll a hotfix release and patch staging+prod carefully.

audit-bot: audit-bot: created ticket SEC-1427: RBAC-refactor-compatibility-audit, linked to PR 3421.

eva: Good. Keep updates here. If anyone notices the canary behavior re-flip, ping in #incidents. 

sam: small note for postmortem: make sure role rename migrations update string literals in service checks or move checks to central permission resolver so we don't have scattered literals.

leah: agreed. Also adding a KMS verification step to the migration playbook so we don't leave decrypt perms behind.
